hero.title: Your Trusted Legal Network Across ASEAN
hero.subtitle: The ASEAN Attorneys Alliance connects you with premier independent law firms in every Southeast Asian nation — delivering local expertise with regional reach.

trustBar.label: Trusted legal expertise across all 11 ASEAN nations

about.mission: The ASEAN Attorneys Alliance is a non-exclusive network of leading independent law firms across all 11 ASEAN member states. We connect businesses with trusted local legal expertise throughout Southeast Asia.
about.pageSubtitle: A premier network of independent law firms united by a shared commitment to excellence in cross-border legal services across Southeast Asia.
about.missionText: To provide seamless access to high-quality legal services across all ASEAN member states through a trusted network of leading independent law firms, enabling businesses to navigate the region's diverse legal landscapes with confidence.
about.visionText: To be the premier legal alliance in Southeast Asia — the first choice for businesses seeking reliable, expert legal counsel across ASEAN jurisdictions.
about.historyText: Founded in 2016, coinciding with the establishment of the ASEAN Economic Community, the Alliance was created to address the growing need for coordinated cross-border legal services as economic integration accelerated across Southeast Asia.
about.step1Text: A business requires legal services in one or more ASEAN jurisdictions.
about.step2Text: Reach out to any member firm or the Alliance directly.
about.step3Text: Get matched with a trusted local firm with the right specialisation.
about.step4Text: Receive coordinated cross-border support with consistent quality.
about.valueIndependenceText: Each member firm maintains full independence while benefiting from the strength of the alliance.
about.valueExcellenceText: Invitation-only membership ensures consistently high standards of legal service across the network.
about.valueIntegrityText: We uphold the highest ethical standards in every jurisdiction we serve.
about.valueCollaborationText: Our members actively share knowledge, referrals, and best practices for the benefit of all clients.

whyAAA.sectionSubtitle: A network built on trust, expertise, and independence — serving businesses across the world's fastest-growing economic region.
whyAAA.coverageText: Member firms in all 11 ASEAN nations providing comprehensive geographic coverage across Southeast Asia.
whyAAA.expertiseText: Each member is a leading independent practice with deep knowledge of local laws, courts, and business customs.
whyAAA.feesText: Direct access to top local firms without the overhead of international firm pricing structures.
whyAAA.qualityText: Rigorous due diligence screening ensures every member meets the highest standards of professional excellence.

cta.title: Join the ASEAN Attorneys Alliance
cta.subtitle: Are you a leading independent law firm in an ASEAN jurisdiction? Join our network of trusted legal professionals and expand your regional reach.

join.pageSubtitle: Become part of ASEAN's premier independent legal network and expand your firm's regional capabilities.
join.benefit1Text: Access a network of trusted firms across all 11 ASEAN nations with standardised service expectations.
join.benefit2Text: Receive and make cross-border referrals with confidence through our vetted member network.
join.benefit3Text: Share legal knowledge and stay updated on regulatory changes across all ASEAN jurisdictions.
join.benefit4Text: Participate in annual conferences, periodic meetings, and professional development events.
join.benefit5Text: Benefit from joint marketing initiatives, newsletters, and the alliance's collective brand presence.
join.benefit6Text: Offer your clients seamless cross-border legal services without the overhead of establishing foreign offices.
join.criteria1: Must be an independent legal practice
join.criteria2: Prominent and well-established in local jurisdiction
join.criteria3: Substantial partner involvement in client matters
join.criteria4: Expertise in commercial, corporate, IP, and litigation
join.processStep1Text: Contact us with your firm's profile and areas of expertise.
join.processStep2Text: Our membership committee conducts a thorough evaluation of your firm.
join.processStep3Text: Existing members review and vote on the application.
join.processStep4Text: Upon approval, your firm is welcomed into the alliance with full membership benefits.
join.faq1Q: Is membership exclusive to one firm per country?
join.faq1A: No, the ASEAN Attorneys Alliance is a non-exclusive network. Multiple firms from the same country may be members.
join.faq2A: Membership dues are structured to be reasonable and proportional. Details are provided during the application process.
join.faq3Q: Can firms belong to other legal networks simultaneously?
join.faq3A: Yes, our non-exclusive model allows member firms to participate in other networks and alliances.
join.faq4A: Members commit to active participation in meetings, prompt responses to referrals, payment of dues, and maintaining professional standards.
